scientific_integrity: Analytic character-branching and convexity proof, corroborated by exact finite enumerations. Finite runs are not a substitute for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Non-lazy, discrete uniform transpositions of two distinct labels, identity initial condition, n>=6; small n and alternate kernels not covered. No claim of historical priority certification.
title: Persistent anticorrelation of fixed points and transpositions in a random transposition walk
